description: HRA exemption per Rule 2A: least of (actual HRA, rent minus 10% of salary, 50% metro / 40% non-metro of salary), computed period-wise. Salary = basic + retirement-forming DA + fixed-percentage turnover commission. Old regime only. Give each period's city: the tool checks it against the fy's rule-pack metro list (FY 2025-26: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai). Also computes the 80GG alternative for rent payers who received no HRA at any time in the year (the two are mutually exclusive).

eightyGG.description: Compute the 80GG alternative instead of HRA (requires: no HRA received at any time in the year)

adjustedTotalIncome.description: Total income before 80GG, excluding LTCG, 111A STCG, and other Chapter VI-A deductions

hraReceivedAnyMonth.description: True if any HRA was received at any time in the year, which bars 80GG outright

months.description: Months rent was paid; the cap limb is Rs 5,000 PER MONTH (FY 2025-26)

rentPaid.description: Total rent paid in the year, INR

periods.description: Homogeneous periods (amounts are per-period TOTALS, not monthly). Split whenever salary, rent, HRA, or city changes. Required unless eightyGG is supplied.

basic.description: Basic salary for the PERIOD in INR

city.description: City of the rented home, e.g. 'Pune'. The tool checks it against the fy's rule-pack metro list, which changes between years, so pass the city rather than deciding metro status yourself.

daRetirement.description: DA forming part of retirement benefits, for the period

hraReceived.description: HRA actually received for the period in INR

isMetro.description: Only when the city cannot be named: true if the rented home is in one of the fy's rule-pack metro cities (list_deductions returns them as hraMetros). Ignored when `city` is given.

months.description: Months in this period; all periods must total 12

rentPaid.description: Rent actually paid for the period in INR

turnoverCommission.description: Commission at a fixed percentage of turnover, per Gestetner

regime.description: HRA exemption and 80GG are both unavailable under the new regime

name: compute_hra
title: Compute HRA exemption (+80GG)
